newsitem.title: USA: New bid made to save United Health, N.J. -- paper.
newsitem.headline: New bid made to save United Health, N.J. -- paper.

text.p: Cathedral Healthcare System and the University of Medicine and Dentistry of New Jersey have joined forces in a $20 million bid to rescue the troubled United Healthcare System's Children's Hospital, the Star-Ledger reported Monday.
The two health facilities proposed to takeover United's pediatric care operation, creating a new facility to be called New Children's Hospital of New Jersey.
If approved by the state and by United, Cathedral and the University would divide transition costs.

United was almost forced to close last month when it was unable to meet its $1.2 million weekly payroll. The state advanced United the money needed to make payroll until United could work out a restructuring, the newspaper said.
